result.summary: Found several visual/layout issues, mainly related to content being cut off at the screen edge and inconsistent card sizing in horizontal scroll sections.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccolo' restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the right edge of the screen, with its name truncated ('Trattoria Piccol').
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll cards are properly clipped/padded so text isn't cut off mid-word, or add a visual indicator (fade/gradient) showing more content is scrollable.

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) has an additional category partially visible and cut off at the right edge.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade gradient or partial visibility cue to indicate more scrollable categories, or adjust spacing so cut-off is less abrupt.

issues.description: The promotional banner card at the very bottom (pizza image with '-100%' badge) is abruptly cropped by the bottom navigation bar, cutting off any text/details.
issues.suggestion: Ensure sufficient bottom padding/margin above the navigation bar so content isn't obscured or awkwardly cropped when scrolling.

issues.description: Inconsistent image aspect ratios/quality between the 'Fastest near you' thumbnails (small square icons) and the 'Popular right now' banners (large rectangular images), creating a visually inconsistent card hierarchy.
issues.suggestion: Standardize image dimensions and aspect ratios across similar card types for better visual consistency.
